'''Denel Moonrunner''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], and the son of two hidden [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], [[Lorn Moonrunner|Lorn]] and [[Artis Moonrunner]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] came to [[Rhamalai]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he was conscripted and given the identification number '''FR-231'''. He had a pet [[gorset]] named [[Chaser (gorset)|Chaser]].
